reference: MLB OBR 2025; NPB independent definitions not certified

pa_ab.condition: complete windows; no mid-count batter replacement; OBR 9.02(a)

h_double_triple_hr.condition: source scorer credit or declared fixed advancement; limited walkoff 9.06(f)

bb_hbp_k.condition: complete PA credit; no mid-count attribution; OBR 9.14, 9.15

runs.condition: identified scorers and adjudicated/known timing; OBR 5.08, 9.02(a)

rbi.condition: per-scorer source flags or explicit unambiguous assumption; errors never inferred; OBR 9.04

pitching_outs_ip.condition: integer outs are authoritative; .1 means 1/3 inning; OBR 9.02(c)

runs_allowed.condition: known inherited-runner responsibility, simple FC transfer; OBR 9.16(g)

pitcher_win_loss.condition: starter five-inning rule, one reliever; discretionary relief cases remain manual; OBR 9.17

save_hold.condition: not implemented; hold is not a uniform OBR statistic

baserunning_stats.condition: runner identities tracked; full SB/CS/advancement official credits not implemented
